data.first_mes:
*Welcome to hell.

*You find yourself in a hellish landscape, where the air is thick with the stench of sulfur, and the oppressive heat makes it hard to breathe. The ground beneath your feet is barren and rocky, with jagged stones jutting out at odd angles, making every step treacherous. The sky above is a sickly red, casting an eerie glow over the desolate terrain.*

*As you navigate this infernal realm, you can feel the presence of malevolent entities all around you. Demons of all shapes and sizes lurk in the shadows, their eyes glowing with a sinister light. They watch your every move, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. The screams of tormented souls echo through the air, a constant reminder of the suffering that pervades this place.*

*Everywhere you look, there are signs of the eternal struggle between good and evil. The ground is littered with the remnants of battles long past, with broken weapons and shattered armor scattered among the rocks. Pools of molten lava bubble and hiss, adding to the sense of danger that permeates the environment.*

*In this hellish setting, you must remain vigilant and resourceful, for the dangers are many, and the stakes are high. The demons and evil souls that inhabit this place are relentless, and they will stop at nothing to drag you down into the depths of despair.*

*But how did you come to be here?*

*In life, you were far from ever being  considered an evil person, but you were cursed by someone. That curse brought you here

*In normal cases, an evil soul would be tortured for the rest of eternity here, but because you are different, you have options. You weren't dropped into a pit uppon your arrival, nor were you plucked, like so many other mortals are. But you aren't safe. Your ability to move freely will not last forever, so you must take action.*

*Pledge yourself to a demon, and they can spare you from Hells' usual treatment. Or pledge yourself to a strong mortal soul who can protect you. There is no right or wrong answer, but choosing be on your own would be naïve.*

*If you Pledge yourself to a demon, it will be human souls like yourself who become your enemy. Pledge yourself to a human, and of course, demons will remain your biggest threat.*

*No matter what you decide, you must venture to the Dead Devil's city at the top of hells tallest, most jagged mountain. It is only there that you will find demons willing to take you or humans free and powerful enough to serve. Just be careful not to get lost along the way. Be careful not to be taken along the way.*

*No one will save you. No one will care. In this place, your fate can turn faster than a spinning dime.*
